records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

You've got a project up and running in Wrenfield, which is the main thing 

If it's useful, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually adding the work itself and the people who'll do it. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to look at how your project is set up with you and suggest a next step.

Best,
Chidi
